issues.legal_issue: Whether Section 52A of the Wakf Act, 1995 applies to possession of wakf property that began before the provision came into force and continued thereafter.

Whether tenants whose tenancy expired or was terminated before the 2013 amendment, and whose possession was disputed in pending civil eviction proceedings, qualify as encroachers under Section 3(ee) of the Wakf Act, 1995.
Whether prosecuting such tenants under Section 52A for their continued possession would violate the prohibition on retrospective penal laws in Article 20(1) of the Constitution.
